prediction: #986 HAKUX_S2T_CVT=1 in Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks' Goro's Lair opening cutscene. Every frame of the cutscene samples three X1R5G5B5 render targets (320x240, 320x120, 160x120) as LU_IMAGE_X1R5G5B5 textures; #59's guard refuses them (cvt), so create_texture() downloads each one: a SURFACE_DOWN finish and a fence wait, 3 a frame, which serialize the PFIFO thread and the GPU. With the switch the three are decoded on the GPU inline, with no finish. Predicted, cutscene windows of the on runs against the off runs: R, sd 0.1 a frame or less and cvt 0 (s2tc near 180 a window instead); P, median G down 6-22 ms, point -10 (43 to ~33 ms: the frame then fits two vblanks; ~29 ms is the bound if nothing else waits); F, median gfps up 5 or more, point +8 (22 to ~30); N, gameplay median gfps no more than 3 below off. A run that fails V (too few cutscene or gameplay windows, the arm's signature missing, or the [s2tcvt] markers wrong for its arm) is void, not a refutation: the route's menu steps were recorded on a disk with no MKSM profile and now meet the golden. R passing with P or F failing refutes "the downloads set the cutscene frame": another wait or the GPU takes their place, and the on runs' phase columns say which.
